reasoning:
DAY CLASS / PRE-INFLUENCE READ: regular block-opening Monday. I inspected the complete served causal slice (32 blocks; 469 immediate fields, with the full 90-play brain available) before using any inherited handoff. There is no A weekend bridge for the block-opening Monday, so I own the read unaided and do not invent an E/A chain label. My independent sign is modest UP, not a squeeze call: Friday's full-session non-price tape ended with positive signed flow (+1333 lots, phase-3 +1157, two-sided buy share rising to 0.521) and the thin Sunday reopen stub also has positive signed flow (+83) but is explicitly demoted as a positioning hint because it has only 315 trades, 558 lots and zero big prints. The raw Sunday b_share 0.466 is not used as a sell signal because its own block says the unsided denominator biases it low; the two-sided share is 0.595. COT is crowded-ish and deteriorating (MM net -105709, WoW -45414, 1y percentile 14.15), which keeps an upside covering tail alive but does not clear the brain's <12 or <3 extreme thresholds that would give covering or seam-UP authority.

GAP / WEEKEND: I refuse point authority on the gap. The weekend weather evidence is mildly supportive rather than coherent: the Sunday-reopen cycle adds +0.32 CDD on D0 and +1.07 on D1, while the model-stability ladder is not a clean multi-horizon same-sign stack (GFS D0 -0.037 CDD, MEX D0 +0.278 then D1-D3 cuts, NAM D0 +0.211). The COT worsening limb is armed but the seam-gap play's extreme-percentile limb is not. Structural gap ownership is also weak: the front is inside seven business days to expiry and backwardated, but squeeze spread change over 3d is -0.002 and the deterministic live flag only says the calendar limb is satisfied, not that a squeeze is active. I therefore use +100 as a low-authority p50 inside a band that must span zero; the session, not the point gap, owns most of the +500 day call.

MONDAY CATCH-UP / FUNDAMENTALS: the 06-10 ET window supplies the strongest positive update. The weekday-open weather cycle raises D0 CDD to 15.219 (+1.211 versus its prior run), with D2 also +0.902. In cooling season I read CDD, not the inert HDD axis. This is supportive demand arrival, but I damp it because the backward-looking grid stack shows a large renewables mask: US48 wind +403232 MWh / +0.0268 share WoW while gas share is -0.0108, and the weekly balance is mixed-to-loose (dry production +1.1 bcfd, total supply +1.7, LNG feedgas -0.7, power +1.4). Storage is not a clean bull either: 3024 Bcf, +162 versus 5y; the last current-vintage +41 print was 4 Bcf tighter than the recovered survey consensus but 5.4 Bcf looser than the same-week seasonal proxy. The next survey consensus is absent, so I do not invent one. These offsets keep the weather/COT setup at a moderate +500 rather than a >1-sigma chase.

MAGNITUDE / SHAPE / FALSIFIER: Monday is a size-up class, but modern Monday mean/median absolute moves in the brain are about 594/615 and the prior full-session n0 range is only 800 at the 20th percentile, with n0 net sigma10 about 621. I center near that class but below one sigma because there is no clean gap owner, no A bridge, no live L1 Monday snapshot, and the emission-ceiling input is absent. The path therefore allows an overnight head-fake/down-drift, then a 06-10 catch-up rally accelerated by the warmer 08:00 weather update, followed by an afternoon give-back as renewable/supply headwinds cap the move. Falsifier for the UP call: if the catch-up window cannot sustain the Friday-positive tilt after the warmer D0 update, or if the fresh flow turns decisively negative rather than merely thin/noisy, the positive session thesis fails. Disposition is CALL with low confidence because the sign has multiple independent supports but no single high-authority seam/covering gate.
